node.title: SOV h-1 fiber Fourier duality
node.statement: For any forced-root conditioned anchored-core fiber and the map c(L)=[X^{h-1}]L to the row field, the largest fiber of c is bounded by the uniform term plus the average of the nontrivial additive character sums of c.
node.attack_surface: finite-field Fourier inversion on the coefficient map
node.falsifier: a finite map to a field whose fiber size exceeds the Fourier-inversion bound
